projects.title: LinuxLab
projects.description: A hands-on Linux practice lab with realistic scenario tasks, an automated grader, progressive hints, and progress tracking. Runs as a Podman/Docker container or installs natively on Debian-based hosts.

projects.title: Log Analyzer
projects.description: A multi-format, async log analysis tool built as a production-depth portfolio project for parsing, filtering, and summarizing large log files.

projects.title: SIEM Log Analyzer & Visualization Tool
projects.description: A log analyzer and visualization tool for security event monitoring, built to aggregate and surface security-relevant findings from log data.

projects.title: System Analysis and Management Toolkit
projects.description: A suite of four advanced Python projects for deep system analysis, hardware profiling, secure WMI management, and high-performance system utilities, built with memory optimization and parallel/async processing.

projects.title: Linux User & Permission Management System
projects.description: A production-grade, fully shell-based CLI tool (usermgr) for managing Linux users, groups, passwords, and file permissions, with parallel bulk operations, structured JSON-lines audit logging, and args-based and interactive modes.

projects.title: SysGuard
projects.description: An async Python CLI that audits Linux user accounts, passwords, sudoers rules, and filesystem permissions, producing structured, risk-ranked security findings with JSON/CSV/text export.

projects.title: Server Hardening Toolkit
projects.description: A professional, fully automated server hardening script built with a DRY function-library architecture. Every module is independent, idempotent, and safe to re-run, with full dry-run support.
